address: 27 Romilly Street, Soho, London, W1D 5AL, United Kingdom
bio: Based on the hole-in-the-wall 'kabab' houses of Tehran, this is a terrifically fun little spot in the heart of Soho. Exposed brick and painted plasterwork suit the buzzy atmosphere, with the best place to sit being at the kitchen counter so you can watch your food being prepared in the tandoor and the mangal barbecue. The cooking is generous and flavoursome, with dishes such as coal-cooked aubergine or lamb shoulder kabab. There’s another branch in Borough Market, if you find yourself in the area....
